title: Wave 1: index integrity — atomic replace, cross-process lock, heal sweep
description: parse_file does lookup → delete_file_cascade (own tx) → upsert_file → per-symbol inserts with no symbols uniqueness constraint; only parse lock is the in-process ParseCoordinator (CLI parse path takes none). Live self-index already holds every src/tools/review.rs symbol twice; unchanged-hash skip means it never self-heals. Finding: parse-race-duplicate-symbols (HIGH). Locations: src/pipeline.rs:176-238, src/main.rs:175, src/db/mod.rs:435-470.

acceptance_criteria.text: per-file delete+upsert+symbol-inserts wrapped in a single transaction
UNIQUE(file_id, qualified_name, start_line) backstop index with conflict handling
OS-level advisory lock (flock on db dir) around parse_workspace covering CLI + stdio + daemon writers
startup integrity sweep detects and clears duplicate symbol rows (existing corrupted indexes heal)
sutra_outline on src/tools/review.rs returns each symbol exactly once against the live index

edges.note: verifying the ref fix against a corrupted index proves nothing — heal duplicates first
